<a name="6.0.0"></a>
# [6.0.0](https://example.invalid/moxystudio/node-cross-spawn/compare/5.1.0...6.0.0) (2018-01-23)


### Bug Fixes

* fix certain arguments not being correctly escaped or causing batch syntax error ([900cf10](https://example.invalid/moxystudio/node-cross-spawn/commit/900cf10)), closes [#82](https://example.invalid/moxystudio/node-cross-spawn/issues/82) [#51](https://example.invalid/moxystudio/node-cross-spawn/issues/51)
* fix commands as posix relatixe paths not working correctly, e.g.: `./my-command` ([900cf10](https://example.invalid/moxystudio/node-cross-spawn/commit/900cf10))
* fix `options` argument being mutated ([900cf10](https://example.invalid/moxystudio/node-cross-spawn/commit/900cf10))
* fix commands resolution when PATH was actually Path ([900cf10](https://example.invalid/moxystudio/node-cross-spawn/commit/900cf10))


### Features

* improve compliance with node's ENOENT errors ([900cf10](https://example.invalid/moxystudio/node-cross-spawn/commit/900cf10))
* improve detection of node's shell option support ([900cf10](https://example.invalid/moxystudio/node-cross-spawn/commit/900cf10))


### Chores

* upgrade tooling
* upgrate project to es6 (node v4)


### BREAKING CHANGES

* remove support for older nodejs versions, only `node >= 4` is supported

# [5.0.0](https://example.invalid/moxystudio/node-cross-spawn/compare/4.0.2...5.0.0) (2016-10-30)


## Features

* add support for `options.shell`
